scope: Independent current local Phase 9 workflow, artifact, site and publication review

findings.finding: Historical success initially ignored a newer failed or cancelled public-api replacement.
findings.resolution: Resolve producer jobs through the current attempt; reject superseded artifacts and run-attempt drift; derive omitted redundant job attempt from its endpoint.

findings.finding: DocC was absent from the local PATH while xcrun could locate it.
findings.resolution: Prepare CLI uses a finite xcrun --find docc fallback, covered by regression.

verifiedContracts: Same-run public-api inputs reach the read-only site job through a nonmatrix immutable output.
The site is required by the exact full coverage gate, with latest API job and named step verification; publication follows that gate.
Manual Documentation only requests the ordinary contained full CI path; no overlapping automatic documentation graph remains.
Native rollout remains closed pending Phase 10; no workflow was dispatched.
Publication rejects PR, scoped, fork, wrong-source, stale-tip, incomplete and older-attempt input context before Pages upload.
Original repository/event/workflow, live default-branch tip, exact current full gate and immutable artifact ID/digest are checked.
Site extraction rejects links, special files, unsafe paths, duplicate members, missing routes/marker, oversized input and existing output.
Release eligibility remains the completed exact-commit ci.yml run and current-attempt full coverage step; github_release.py is unchanged.

limitations: Root owns full-suite validation and final retained-input/commit reconciliation; this review directly executed 71 focused tests.
Real DocC evidence uses synthetic local catalogs/graphs and Xcode 27.1 DocC, not the hosted pinned Swift 6.4.1 toolchain or all production modules.
No hosted CI, native Swift compilation, paid execution, remote write, publication, deployment or live Discord qualification occurred.
Publication deliberately requires a current-attempt site producer; a partial rerun can reuse older successful site preparation for certification but cannot publish that older artifact.
Hosted artifact round trips, partial reruns, actual check-context behavior, cost and pinned-toolchain complete native qualification remain Phase 11 work.
